name: YouVersion Bible
description: Look up a passage in the licensed Bibles YouVersion offers (NIV, NASB, AMP and many more) and add it to the schedule. Passages one chapter at a time; whole Bibles and books are never downloaded, and the text is kept only as long as each publisher allows. OpenSanctuary releases include a YouVersion key; you can use your own instead, kept in your computer's secure storage.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the Bible library
The server asks the YouVersion Platform for the list of Bibles and for the passage you look up (adding the app's key, or your own in the X-YVP-App-Key header), and contacts no other host
Keeps your own YouVersion Platform App Key, if you choose to use one instead of the built-in key, in secure storage that only this plugin can read

Saves the passage you choose to add (one chapter or part of one) in your Bible library so it can be scheduled and shown. It is stored sealed and deleted when its publisher's time limit runs out. It can replace a saved passage of the same book, chapter, verses and version
Adds the passage you chose to the schedule, and fills in the text of passages on a schedule you opened by looking them up again
